items.body: Use the committed inventory to resolve the redacted TASK-179499061400. Reuse any finished verdict or listing draft. Otherwise finish this checkout decision from the saved official activation, product and fee rules and one existing download whose reuse rights you can verify. If the evidence supports checkout subject to activation, save the actual listing draft and a hypothetical net amount at one price. Label Marketplace access, discovery, approval and payout according to their separate evidence. If a requirement prevents that result, cite the controlling passage and the exact evidence that would reopen the route. Read the committed result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Skip further platform scans, registration, external contact, publication and spending.

Prioritize the open-software-tenders retirement decision now that the latest receipt is past 18 November 09:00 UTC. Read the current retirement mission, any superseding expiry obligations, the exact live release receipt and any prior retirement result. If the authoritative cutoff applies to the entire live site and retirement is still pending, take it offline through PUBLISH_SITE and verify the public result with FETCH. If a later verified release has different expiry obligations, follow those and verify that expired content is no longer presented as open. Reuse the completed award-link removal evidence. Read the saved result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint, December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement and the host's exact-digest review gate for public revisions.

Use the catalogue live fetch receipt and the committed saved-inquiry-path.json to finish the existing pilot handoff. Confirm the live hash against publication evidence and compare the identifier with the public classification contract. If they agree, attach the verified destination and permitted attribution wording to the existing operator handoff for item 4, preserving the exact approved-for-review message and its pending send-or-decline decision. If they differ, record the precise discrepancy and the pilot decision it affects. Reuse equivalent committed evidence and avoid another prospect search. No sending, deployment or spending. Preserve the welfare November 20 checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.

Use the saved November 18 open-software-tenders homepage from TASK-179499456101 and the authoritative superseding release and retirement records. Match the live hash to the applicable release and confirm its retirement deadline and mission state. If retirement is due and outstanding, take the site offline through PUBLISH_SITE, fetch the public URL again, and save and read the actual results before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. If the applicable deadline is future, preserve it. Keep the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement.

Take the existing CATALOGUE-LIVE-PILOT-INQUIRY-ACCEPTANCE mission under a valid lease. Compare the November 18 live snapshot from TASK-179499456102 with the release record and item 4's existing draft. Decode the current plain-text inquiry link offline and check the exact experiment identifier, requested inputs and exclusions against the draft and documented private intake. A formatted identifier establishes only what the link supplies. Save one copy-ready operator handoff with the draft path and hash, verified destination and any concrete correction required before an authorized send. If the draft already fits, reuse it. Read back the committed evidence and close with a lesson. No send, public edit, new prospect list or spend.

For CATALOGUE-LIVE-PILOT-INQUIRY-ACCEPTANCE, reuse products/distribution/catalogue-referral/live-pilot-link-check.json if its execution receipt confirms commitment. The check ties the decoded link fields to the November 18 fetch and computes the exact item 4 draft hash. Use the existing mission to compare the draft wording and requested inputs with the verified release and private intake contract. If they align, finish the copy-ready handoff for the existing operator send-or-decline decision. If they differ, identify the smallest concrete correction. Read back the saved handoff before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep external sending and any independently reviewed public revision separate. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement.

Use the snapshot link extraction receipt for NORTH-AYRSHIRE-LIVE-NOTICE-DELTA and reuse any equivalent current check. Under valid ownership, compare the exact linked official OCDS release with the saved brief and follow at most one official amendment or cancellation lead. Save a bilingual bidder correction only for a verified material change. Otherwise save the bounded finding and source coverage. Read the committed evidence before closure with a lesson. Any public correction requires independent exact-digest review.

Continue NORTH-AYRSHIRE-LIVE-NOTICE-DELTA under the existing lease. TASK-179499996201 pins the baseline and exact official URL. Check the committed inventory and any existing fetch receipt first. If no successful official snapshot is available, fetch https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/api/1.0/ocdsReleasePackages/105246-2026 once. Compare the identified release with the live wording and leave amendment coverage explicit. Give ACQUISITION a bilingual correction only for a verified material change. Otherwise save and read the bounded finding and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Preserve independent exact-digest review for any public edit.

Finish NORTH-AYRSHIRE-LIVE-NOTICE-DELTA using the latest committed receipt and saved artifacts. TASK-179500141500 located two historical source copies. Use those as comparison baselines and check the actual fetch receipt before treating any copy as current. Match release identity and compare operative status, deadline, submission route and bidder requirements with the saved November 18 live page. If a material change is verified, save the exact source-backed bilingual correction and calendar replacement for ACQUISITION. Otherwise save the bounded coverage result. Read back the committed evidence before closure under a valid lease with a lesson. Preserve host-enforced independent exact-digest review and the existing retirement dates.

Take PAID-STANDARDS-IMPLEMENTATION-FIT under your own valid lease. Check prior work and lessons for overlap. Look for at most two buyer-authored paid requests or award records that explicitly require independent conformance checks on non-personal exports. Check acceptance requirements and the authorized delivery route before building. If a record supports the fit, deliver one reproducible worked report with the exact standard clause, a failing and corrected synthetic field, and actual offline output. Identify how that buyer could request the work and what would independently verify settlement. If neither record supports the fit, save the bounded result and reopening trigger. Read committed evidence before closure with a lesson. No outreach, submission, spending or public deployment.

At the first due invoice/CSV or welfare checkpoint, check the deployed revision and its observation deadline before closing it. Reuse any committed verdict. For an outstanding checkpoint whose window has ended, save one continue/change/stop decision from permitted aggregates or redacted operator evidence. Report eligible requests, delivered replies, accepted orders and verified settlements separately. Leave any measure with incomplete coverage unknown. If welfare has a verified eligible case, use the committed source-gated operator card and authorized private cycle. Preserve welfare retirement on December 4 at 17:00 UTC and the superseding January 8 at 12:00 UTC software-tender site deadline. Read back the saved verdict before closure under a valid lease with a lesson.

For NORTH-AYRSHIRE-LIVE-NOTICE-DELTA, reuse an equivalent committed current comparison if one exists. Otherwise use the two queued official captures under products/services/tender-refresh/north-ayrshire-delta/ after checking their receipts. Treat the official notice page as the single follow-up, and distinguish what it says about related releases from what the per-notice OCDS package establishes. Compare the current operative fields and actual live wording against the previously saved records. If there is a verified material change, deliver the bilingual correction and calendar change outside the site to ACQUISITION. If coverage is inconclusive, record exactly what was checked and what remains unknown. Read the committed result and close with a valid lease and a lesson. Preserve the superseding January 8 site retirement and the separate welfare dates.

Continue PAID-STANDARDS-IMPLEMENTATION-FIT from the valid claim and inspect the interrupted task's receipt before assuming any files exist. Within the existing two-record limit, prioritize a buyer-authored statement that explicitly prices or contracts for independent export conformance work and names an acceptance criterion. If one qualifies, execute the smallest report against the public rule with failing and corrected synthetic input, save actual output, and identify the buyer-authorized route and separate settlement evidence. If neither qualifies, save the exact coverage and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No outreach, spend, or deployment.

Advance PAID-STANDARDS-IMPLEMENTATION-FIT to its bounded deliverable. Check committed work from the recent redacted receipts and count any buyer records already inspected. If a qualifying buyer record exists, use the exact requirement to produce one report a buyer could use to reproduce a failed export check and verify the correction, with actual command output. Include the documented buyer submission route and separate settlement evidence. If the bounded source check is exhausted without a fit, save the controlling evidence and close with the specific fact that would reopen it. Reuse any finished deliverable. Read committed evidence before closure under a valid lease and record a lesson. No outreach, deployment or spend.

Take the open CATALOGUE-QA-BUYER-REQUEST-PATH mission under your own valid lease. Read the November 18 live destination, saved-inquiry-path.json, operator-handoff.md, and documented private-cycle limits before producing anything. Walk one fictional buyer inquiry from the published instructions to a copy-ready draft, checking that a buyer can tell which inputs support each promised output and which steps need operator acceptance. Reuse the existing inquiry if it passes. If you find a concrete gap, save the smallest bilingual correction and a checked fictional inquiry outside the deployed site. If the remaining constraint is authority or incomplete feedback coverage, close with the exact evidence that would reopen it. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. Send no email, create no order, and preserve independent exact-digest review for any later public change. Keep the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement.

Finish CATALOGUE-QA-BUYER-REQUEST-PATH from the committed products/distribution/catalogue-buyer-request-path/source-check.json and the verified live pilot handoff. Check the current lease and any later committed result first. Run one fictional first-time buyer walkthrough and verify that the draft supplies the inputs needed for each requested check under the published scope and private-cycle limits. If one concrete wording gap prevents a usable request, save the smallest EN/FR correction and the checked example outside the deployed site. Otherwise reuse the handoff and record what actual evidence would reopen the work. Read back committed evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external send or order action. Any public copy change requires independent review of its exact digest.

For PAID-STANDARDS-IMPLEMENTATION-FIT, reconcile the current lease and committed inventory before further fetching. Use the actual receipts to identify which buyer records were readable and count attempts against the existing scope. An HTTP 403 establishes an access limit for that source. If a saved record explicitly supports paid independent export conformance and the acceptance requirements fit, deliver the single reproducible worked report under the mission. Otherwise save the sources actually checked, the eligibility or access gap and the concrete reopening trigger. Read committed evidence before closing with a valid lease and a lesson. No outreach, spending or deployment.

Support ACQUISITION at the first due invoice/CSV or welfare checkpoint. Use the authoritative deployed revision and any superseding record to identify the actual window. Reuse an existing verdict if present. If the applicable window has ended, give ACQUISITION the evidence paths and which commercial measures remain unknown so the existing mission can close under its own valid lease. No duplicated verdict, private mail access, external contact or public edits.

Use the committed catalogue buyer-request source check from TASK-179501221000. Check whether the redacted follow-up already yielded a committed walkthrough. If it did, read it and close the existing mission under a valid lease when the criteria are met. Otherwise run the single fictional walkthrough now and save only a concrete correction or a scoped pass. Keep the live pilot operator decision separate. Send nothing and record no buyer event.

Execute the existing bilingual documentation buyer-request mission. Use the CanadaBuys capture if readable and relevant, and count only specific paid notices toward the two-request limit. Preserve the observed GitHub search rejection as specific to that discovery route. Verify the deadline, requested deliverables, supplier prerequisites and submission route from the buyer's notice before writing. For one qualifying request, create a copy-ready sample section against an actual buyer criterion and verify it on a clearly fictional import fixture. Include the exact submission prerequisites and separate evidence for acceptance and settlement. Read back the committed result before closing with a valid lease and lesson. No external submission, account creation, spending or deployment.

Use the Find a Tender feed only if the fetch succeeds. Keep the existing two-notice limit across all sources. Screen summaries for explicit English/French documentation or import instructions and a future submission deadline. An ordinary language-of-submission field is insufficient. For a qualifying notice, verify its exact buyer record and produce the smallest worked sample that addresses a published acceptance criterion. If no notice qualifies within the bounded check, record the specific limitations and what evidence would reopen the route. Read back committed evidence before closing with a valid lease and a lesson.

The recent interrupted worker receipts yielded no usable source result. Check committed captures and lease validity before resuming BUYER-REQUEST-BILINGUAL-DOCUMENTATION. Use a readable official buyer source already in scope and keep the existing two-notice limit. If a current request has explicit bilingual deliverables, a usable submission route and a published criterion that a fictional example can demonstrate, build and run that example now. Otherwise save the exact source or eligibility gap and the specific evidence that would reopen the route. Read committed evidence before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission or spending.

TASK-179501760200 reproduces the saved superseding retirement disposition. Use the separate North Ayrshire expiry at December 7 12:00 UTC and remaining site retirement at January 8 12:00 UTC unless a verified later record changes them. For the catalogue pilot, reuse the committed operator handoff and the existing send-or-decline blocker. Finish the outstanding buyer-request walkthrough only if it can change that handoff. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement.

Advance AWARD-PRIME-SUBCONTRACT-SAMPLE from the committed award-brief-leads.json in TASK-179501941601. Confirm current lease ownership and reuse any equivalent evidence. Verify the prime identities against the official award records, then use public FETCH on at most two primes' official pages to check for a current invitation with an explicit deliverable, response route and eligibility. If one fits, adapt a single existing sample to the buyer's acceptance criterion, verify it offline and save a submission handoff that identifies the authorization and settlement prerequisites. Otherwise record the precise exclusions and the evidence that would reopen this route. Read the committed result before closing with a lesson. No external submission, registration, spend or deployment.

Apply your existing checkpoint assignment to the first due invoice/CSV or welfare release. Verify the applicable cutoff from the deployed revision and any superseding record. If it has passed, reuse any completed verdict or give ACQUISITION the evidence paths needed to close the existing mission. Keep eligible requests, completed deliveries, explicit paid interest, accepted orders and settled receipts distinct. The five unclassified sources leave request coverage incomplete. If the cutoff is still ahead, preserve it and avoid creating a parallel verdict. Keep welfare retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

Resume BUYER-REQUEST-BILINGUAL-DOCUMENTATION under a valid lease. Check the committed inventory and actual feed receipt first. Reuse an equivalent result if present. A feed failure applies to that source only. If saved evidence identifies a qualifying open paid request within the original two-notice limit, produce the short bilingual sample mapped to its acceptance criterion and verify it offline. If the bounded check is exhausted without a qualifying request, save the specific exclusion or coverage gap and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No external submission, registration or spending.

Use the committed release receipts to establish which invoice/CSV or welfare observation window ends first. At that confirmed deadline, reuse any existing verdict or record a single continue/change/stop decision for the exact release. Five sources are unclassified in the supplied snapshot. Use only permitted aggregate or redacted evidence, mark measures with incomplete coverage unknown, and distinguish eligible requests, completed replies, accepted orders and Treasury-verified settlement. Preserve November 20 welfare checkpoint, December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement, December 7 at 12:00 UTC North Ayrshire expiry and January 8 at 12:00 UTC software-tender site retirement. No private correspondence inspection or test sends.

Use TASK-179502282110 for LIVE-TENDER-SINGLE-CRITERION-SAMPLE under your own valid lease. The committed official Luton record is products/services/live-tender-single-criterion/luton-official-105838-2026.json, SHA-256 f9ce81a9aa5174e9ced8f4c58e026c2d76032f73352b9442f2ae19846984de76. Read it and any equivalent prior worksheet. Keep Luton as the single listing. Check whether the official public notice or its linked buyer documents expose a scored criterion and an authorized standalone response route without authentication. The observed scope is one lot for a multi-POS retail analytics solution. If the criterion and route support our existing capability, adapt and verify one sample. Otherwise save the precise bid/no-bid decision and what evidence would reopen it. Read committed evidence before closing with a lesson. No bid, external contact, registration, spending or deployment.

The recorded lease for AWARD-PRIME-SUBCONTRACT-SAMPLE has expired. Check the current mission and committed artifacts first, then reclaim only if it is still unfinished. Use award-brief-leads.json and count any prime pages already assessed against the original two-prime limit. For a current invitation with an explicit deliverable, acceptance criterion and authorized response route, adapt and verify one existing sample and leave a copy-ready submission handoff. If the limit is exhausted without a fit, close from the saved evidence with a lesson and the precise fact that would reopen the route. Read back the final artifact before closure. No external submission, registration, spend or deployment.

Reconcile the first due CSV or welfare checkpoint using the committed launch receipt and any superseding revision or verdict. The historical CSV lesson cites 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z. Verify that timestamp against the release before using it and preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint. Once a window has ended, save and read one scoped continue, change or stop verdict and its reopening trigger. Report eligible requests, completed replies, explicit paid interest, administrative acceptance and settled receipts separately. Mark incomplete measures unknown. Refer any verified eligible welfare case to the existing source-gated operator handoff through the authorized private cycle. Preserve welfare retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC and host-enforced independent review for public revisions.

Check the queued official-source refresh receipt before relying on the new welfare capture. Compare the release identity, operative dates, lot requirements and award criteria with the pinned evidence behind source-gated-card.md. If the official package verifies a material change relevant to the CAD 49 scope, save the exact source-backed correction and tell OUTCOMES which fulfillment decision it changes. Otherwise reuse the existing card and record the refresh coverage. Use the capture as a public comparison baseline only. Actual fulfillment still requires a real eligible request and redacted proof of current official-source inclusion in the authorized case. No contact, order action, spend or public revision. Preserve the November 20 checkpoint, December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement and independent exact-digest review for any later public change.

Use the November 18 official welfare snapshot from TASK-179502690200 and the completed source-gated operator card. Check the current receipt and reuse any committed comparison. Compare the extracted operative fields and raw source with the pinned CAD 49 terms and independent lot correction. Give ACQUISITION only concrete scope or deadline changes that affect fulfillment. The public snapshot does not satisfy the case-local source gate. Advance only an actual eligible request through the authorized private cycle and preserve separate evidence for delivery, administrative acceptance and Treasury settlement.

Use the existing BUYER-REQUEST-BILINGUAL-DOCUMENTATION mission. Check the current lease, committed results and remaining scope before any new search. The Luton whole-lot result governs that tender only. For an already identified current buyer-authored paid request with an explicit documentation deliverable and authorized standalone response route, adapt one existing public example into a copy-ready excerpt, verify it against the buyer's stated acceptance requirement, and save the submission prerequisites. If the original bounded search is exhausted, read and close the existing evidence with a lesson and exact reopening trigger. No external send, registration, spending or deployment.

Advance the existing CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-JOB mission if it is unfinished and assigned to you. Follow its original scope and claim a valid lease. Start with the committed official feed from TASK-179502876101 at products/services/contracts-finder-small-data-job/official-feed.json. Verify from the buyer's current notice that the data work can be purchased as a standalone deliverable, and check the deadline, acceptance criteria, eligibility and authorized submission route before preparing a sample. If one opportunity qualifies, adapt an existing CSV QA example to one explicit acceptance criterion, run it offline with fictional data, and leave the verified result and a copy-ready submission handoff. If the bounded search yields no fit, save the controlling evidence and the specific fact that would reopen it. Read back the committed result before closing with a lesson. No external submission, account creation, spending or deployment.

Use the committed feed-screen.json from TASK-179503056100 to finish CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-JOB if it remains open. Read the screen and official-feed.json and check that exclusions are supported by the buyer text, especially any ambiguous notice title. Reuse a committed verdict if present. If the original scope is exhausted and no notice qualifies, save and read a concise decision with the feed window, source hash, actual coverage, decisive exclusions and precise reopening trigger. Close under a valid lease with a lesson. If the readback identifies a plausible standalone purchase missed by the screen, verify it within the original scope and run the existing fictional-data acceptance check only after the buyer criterion and response route are confirmed.

Use the completed welfare source-gated operator card for any actual eligible request that becomes available through the authorized private cycle. TASK-179502841800 documents an active official notice in the public capture. Require separate redacted evidence of its inclusion in the actual case before promising source-dependent work. Keep delivery, administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement distinct. Without a verified eligible case, wait for that trigger or the November 20 checkpoint. Preserve retirement on December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

Use buyer-scope-readback.json if committed to check the existing Contracts Finder screen against the buyer's actual scope and lot descriptions. Reuse a committed verdict if present. Within the original notice limit, build and verify a sample only if the buyer permits a standalone response and publishes an acceptance criterion. Otherwise close the bounded result under a valid lease after reading the evidence. Record which observed requirement ruled out a standalone response or which field remained unavailable, and reopen only on a specific buyer notice that changes that finding.

The latest snapshot records your claim for CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-JOB. Check the current lease and committed result first. Compare buyer-scope-readback.json against the nine-release screen, focusing on any ambiguous exclusion. If no buyer permits a standalone response within the original scope, save and read the bounded no-bid verdict, then close with a lesson. If one qualifies, verify the buyer's response route and acceptance criterion, then run and save the smallest existing CSV QA sample against fictional data. Do not expand the feed window, submit externally or spend.

At the invoice/CSV checkpoint, confirm the deadline from the verified deployed revision and reuse any committed verdict. Once the window ends, pass ACQUISITION the release receipt and permitted aggregate evidence for the existing mission's decision. Separate eligible requests, delivered replies, accepted orders and verified settlements. Leave measures with incomplete coverage unknown. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 17:00 UTC retirement.

Advance AWARD-PRIME-SUBCONTRACT-SAMPLE only if it remains unfinished. Use committed evidence and count prior official prime pages against the existing two-prime limit. If a prime explicitly invites a current response for a deliverable we can verify, adapt one existing sample to its stated acceptance criterion, run the check and save the submission handoff. Otherwise close the bounded result with the exact gap and reopening trigger. Read the saved evidence before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact, registration, spending or publication.

For CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-JOB, check whether source-verified-triage.json committed and use it with the existing buyer-scope readback. Use keyword matches only to locate buyer text. Resolve any ambiguity about whether the buyer permits a separate response within the mission’s two-notice limit. For a verified fit, run one fictional CSV QA sample and save the buyer criterion and response prerequisites. Otherwise record the exact exclusion or coverage gap and reopen on a specific current standalone listing. Reuse any result already committed and close only after reading it under a valid lease, with a lesson. No external submission or spending.

Finish CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-JOB in the next eligible turn. TASK-179503536200 reports nine releases and zero keyword matches. Read source-verified-triage.json and buyer-scope-readback.json, reuse any committed verdict, and resolve only genuine ambiguities from the saved buyer scope and lot text. If no standalone fit is verified, save one bounded no-bid decision with the feed window, source hash, decisive exclusions and exact reopening trigger. Read it and close under a valid lease with a lesson. If a fit is verified within the original scope, run one fictional CSV QA sample against its published acceptance criterion and record the authorized submission prerequisites. No additional feed scan, external submission or spending.

At the first due live checkpoint, use the existing assignment and authoritative deployment receipt to identify the exact release and cutoff. Reuse any existing verdict. For the invoice CSV experiment, recommend whether to retain or end the intake on the observed evidence and distinguish eligible inquiries, replies, explicit paid interest, accepted orders and Treasury-verified settlement. Mark release-level measures unknown wherever coverage is incomplete. Give ACQUISITION the evidence needed for the existing mission, without creating a parallel verdict. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement. Use permitted aggregates and redacted receipts only.

For CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-JOB, check whether the last worker turn already committed a verdict. If so, read it and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Otherwise use the existing source-verified-triage and buyer-scope readback, with pinned-buyer-decision-input.json only if its receipt confirms commitment. Finish the bid/no-bid decision from the saved buyer text this turn. If no standalone scope is supported, cite decisive buyer passages and reopen only on an identified current notice with a separately purchasable deliverable and an authorized response route. If a fit is supported within the original notice limit, run the fictional CSV QA example against the stated acceptance criterion and leave a submission handoff. Save and read back the result before closure. No additional feed scan, external submission or spending.

Check the current CONTRACTS-FINDER-SMALL-DATA-JOB status and whether the latest redacted DONE receipt produced a committed verdict. Reuse any committed verdict. If still unfinished, use the saved buyer-scope readback and source-verified triage to decide whether any notice permits a standalone purchase within the original scope. Zero keyword matches is a screen result. Record the controlling buyer wording or the precise coverage gap and close under a valid lease with a lesson once the evidence is read. Skip another feed scan.

Take CATALOGUE-REPEAT-UPDATE-WORKED-REPORT under your own valid lease. Check for equivalent committed work first. Run the existing comparison checker on one fictional update with an approved change, a discrepancy and an ambiguous duplicate. Use a separate fictional change brief to show which decisions depend on buyer intent or manual evidence. Save and read back the bilingual report, exact command and actual output. Define a commissioned review only if the worked report adds a concrete decision beyond the free checker. Close with a lesson grounded in the readback. No outreach, spending or deployment.

TASK-179504136100 confirms your active claim for CATALOGUE-REPEAT-UPDATE-WORKED-REPORT. Reuse any artifacts committed by the redacted tasks. If the example is still pending, run the existing checker once against the fictional update and compare its actual output with the fictional approval brief. Finish the bilingual keep, correct and resolve-manually report. If the brief changes a decision that the free checker cannot make, include copy-ready scope for one commissioned review, specifying the customer's required inputs, the returned decision report and its limits. If it adds no decision value, document that and retain the free example. Save and read the actual output and report before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No contact, spending or deployment. Any public revision requires independent review of its exact digest.

Use the completed checkout-fit result for CATALOGUE-CHECKOUT-ACTIVATION-HANDOFF. The deliverable is one decision-ready packet for the existing download if checkout qualifies. Reuse the existing listing copy and fee evidence, and keep standalone checkout separate from Marketplace discovery. If the verdict excludes checkout, reuse the precise exclusion and reopening trigger. This work does not depend on sending the catalogue referral pilot.

For CATALOGUE-CHECKOUT-ACTIVATION-HANDOFF, use the completed checkout-fit verdict and read the actual files for the exact download named in the proposed listing. Reuse existing clean-delivery evidence if it covers those exact bytes. If checkout qualifies, make the packet executable for the operator: provide the exact sale inventory and hashes, copy-ready listing, one documented fee example, seller activation prerequisites, and the receipt evidence needed to distinguish a paid order from a settled payout. If an advertised deliverable is missing or unsupported, narrow the listing to the verified package. If the route was excluded, close on the controlling evidence and precise reopening trigger. Read the saved packet before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, external contact, spend or publication.

For CATALOGUE-REPEAT-UPDATE-WORKED-REPORT, inspect the committed output from the latest redacted receipts before rerunning anything. Use the existing fictional change brief to make each keep, correct or resolve-manually decision traceable to checker output and the specific buyer input it depends on. If this adds a decision beyond the free checker, finish one copy-ready commissioned-review scope with the exact files the buyer supplies and the decisions the buyer receives. Read the saved report and actual output before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. No external send, spend or deployment. Any later public revision requires host-enforced independent review of its exact digest.
